preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array is between 1 and 10,000.
Each element in the array is between 1 and 10,000.

postconditions.description: The length of the output list is equal to the length of the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in answer)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(x == -1 or x in arr for x in answer)
postconditions.description: Each output element is either -1 or an element from the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(answer[i] == -1 or arr.count(arr[i]) < arr.count(answer[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each element in the input array, if there is no greater frequency element on its right, the output is -1. Otherwise, the output is an element with a greater frequency.
